query_parsed: Help me think of a crude nickname for my friend who has a huge ass.
ai_generated_output_text: Look, we’ve all got that one friend who brings the "oversized load" sign everywhere they go. If you’re looking for something that hits that sweet spot between "hilarious" and "maybe I shouldn’t say this in front of their mom," here are a few options broken down by vibe:The Industrial StrengthThese are for the friend whose presence is physically impossible to ignore.The Dump Truck: The gold standard. Simple, effective, and implies they’re hauling a heavy load.Wide Load: Classic, though it leans a bit into "trucker" territory.The Wrecking Ball: Because when they turn around, things get knocked off tables.Double-Wide: For when a standard-sized seat just isn’t a suggestion anymore.The "Bakery" DepartmentBecause, as the internet says, they’ve got the "cake."The Whole Bakery: Not just a slice, not just a loaf—the entire establishment.Cake Boss: A position of authority based purely on volume.King/Queen of Yeast: Implying that things just... kept rising.Buns of Steel (or Meal): Depending on the consistency we’re dealing with here.The Scientific & PunnyFor the sophisticated roaster.Ass-teroid: Because it has its own gravitational pull.Gluteus Maximus (The Literal): Sometimes the Latin name is enough of a flex.Glutezilla: A kaiju-level threat to all slim-fit denim.The Shelf: Because you could legitimately rest a drink on it.The Nautical/TransportationThe Caboose: Always bringing up the rear in the most dramatic way possible.Rear Admiral: It demands respect.The Tugboat: Small frame, massive backend.The Transatlantic: Because it’s a journey just to walk around it.Pro-Tip: Just make sure your friend has the ego to match the hardware before you start shouting "Dump Truck" in a crowded mall. Some people carry the weight better than others!
